page.title: Roleplay System
page.description: Activity tracking, requirements, ranking, applications and logs for Roblox roleplay groups.

activity.title: Know exactly who shows up.
activity.text: A Roblox module reports who (Alvin) is in your game every minute. The dashboard turns it into hours, sessions, idle time and chat activity for every member in a tracked rank.

step1.heading: Total hours, daily or weekly
step1.text: Switch the graph between days and weeks, then filter the leaderboard by today, this week, last week, 30 days, all time or any custom date range.
step1.point1: A weekday-by-hour heatmap of when members actually play
step1.point3: Sessions, chat messages and who is in game right now
step1.point4: CSV export, and manual adjustments that are always logged

step2.heading: A profile for every member
step2.text: Twelve weeks of history, recent play sessions, requirement results, time off, linked Discord, plus notes and warnings your staff and Alvin can leave.

step3.heading: Daily & weekly requirements
step3.text: Set a minimum, override it per rank, and pick the hour checks run. Anyone who misses it is logged and posted to a Discord webhook, with your own customized message, a role mention and pings for linked members.
step3.point1: Progress bars update live through the week

step4.heading: Time off that actually excuses
step4.text: Members request time off from a bot or staff add it directly. Approved time off overlapping a period automatically excuses them from a requirement check.

ranking.title: Promote without leaving the dashboard.
ranking.text: Promote, demote or set any rank through Roblox Open Cloud, from a member’s profile, the ranking page, an accepted application or the API.
ranking.point1: A ceiling on the highest rank the system may assign
ranking.point2: The group owner can never be touched
ranking.point3: Every change logged with who, why and from/to

demo.image: Ranking page listing group roles, tracked ranks and recent rank changes
demo.image2: Change rank dialog with member, action and reason fields

promotions.title: Let your team pick who’s next.
promotions.text: Anyone can nominate a member for promotion. Staff upvote with a short justification, so every vote comes with a reason, and a ranker can promote straight from the card.
promotions.point1: Filter by rank, sort by most votes, trending or newest
promotions.point2: Recommender insights: who suggests most, and how often it lands
promotions.point3: Promoting moves them up one rank through Open Cloud

demo.image: Promotion recommendations with upvotes, justifications and recommender insights

logs.title: Everything it does, written down.
logs.text: Promotions, demotions, missed requirements, time off, applications, sign-ins, settings changes, API keys — every action lands in a searchable log, and can be mirrored to a Discord channel per group.
logs.label: rank.promoterank.demoterequirement.not_mettimeoff.approvedapplication.submittedaccess.granted

demo.image: Log page filtered to one group showing promotions, applications and sign-ins

logbook.title: Warnings that expire. A record that doesn’t.
logbook.text: Log warnings, strikes, suspensions, demotions, promotions and commendations with a reason and evidence link. Warnings expire on their own, and entries are revoked, never deleted.
logbook.point1: Warning ticker: active warnings per member at a glance
logbook.point3: Promotions and demotions can change the rank at the same time

demo.image: Logbook with the warning ticker and entries with evidence links
demo.image2: Member profile with active warnings, sessions attended and their logbook

groups.title: One dashboard, every group.
groups.text: Add as many Roblox groups as you run. Each keeps its own tracked ranks, requirements, Open Cloud key, webhooks, applications and API keys

demo.image: Groups page with two groups and their tracked-rank checkboxes

applications.title: Application centers you design.
applications.text: Build the questions in the dashboard. Applicants answer on the web or inside your Roblox game, and everything comes fresh from the API.

step1.heading: Forms as flexible as Google Forms
step1.text: Eleven question types including date and time, an “Other” option people type into, shuffled options, scale labels and response validation (numbers, text, length, patterns or how many boxes to tick) with a customizable error message.

step2.heading: Review, score, auto-rank
step2.text: See every answer with its auto-score. Your Discord server gets every answer too, with a Decide button that opens the submission. Accept and the applicant can be ranked automatically through Open Cloud.

step3.heading: A shareable web form
step3.text: Every application gets a public link. Require a Discord sign-in with a linked Roblox account, or let applicants type their username.

step4.heading: A Roblox place, generated
step4.text: One click downloads a ready-to-publish .rbxlx application center. It holds no questions, it fetches them from the API, so edits go live in-game instantly.

sessions.title: Session registers and targets.
sessions.text: Schedule shifts, trainings and events. Staff claim them as host or co-host, and the register records who attended — which counts towards a weekly session target alongside activity minutes.
sessions.point1: Paste a list of names to fill a register in one go
sessions.point3: New sessions announced to Discord with a live countdown

demo.image: Sessions page listing shifts, trainings and events
demo.image2: Session register listing the host, co-host and attendees

kb.title: Handbooks, policies and news in one place.
kb.text: Write your staff handbook, guides and policies with simple formatting, grouped by category, and limit sensitive pages to people with a specific permission. Post news to the whole group and pin what matters.
kb.point1: Published at /posts and /handbooks — public, staff-only, or for one permission
kb.point2: Restricted pages ask people to sign in, then bring them straight back
kb.point3: Live preview while you write, and optional Discord announcements

demo.image: Knowledgebase page showing the staff handbook
demo.image2: Group news with a pinned announcement

linking.title: Discord, Google and Roblox — linked.
linking.text: Members sign in with Discord, get a one-time code and type it in a verification game. The Roblox player is identified by the server, so nobody can link someone else’s account.
linking.point1: Staff sign in with Google or Discord and link the other
linking.point2: Linked members get pinged in requirement notices
linking.point3: One verification game for every group, with a Join to Verify button and an automatic kick once linked
linking.point4: Tracker module and app center downloadable per group

demo.image: Roblox setup dialog with downloads for the tracker module and the application center
demo.image2: Verification page: sign in with Discord to get a link code

access.title: Sign in, pick a group, get to work.
access.text: After signing in you choose where to work. Every group you can open shows live numbers on its card, and you can switch groups any time from the top bar.
access.point1: Whitelist only, not on it yet? Ask for access right from the sign-in page
access.point2: Per-person permissions: ranking, logs, applications, groups, API keys
access.point3: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> to jump to any page, group or member

demo.image: Group picker after sign-in, with live numbers on every group

anywhere.title: Light, dark, desktop or phone.
anywhere.text: Every page follows your system theme or the one you pick, and works on a phone, so you can approve time off from anywhere.

discord.title: Your Discord, kept in the loop.
discord.text: Webhooks per group and per job, so each message lands in the right channel — no bot to host.
discord.point1: Reminders before sessions start, with a role ping
discord.point2: “Staff of the week” posted automatically every week
discord.point3: Applications with every answer and a Decide button
discord.point4: Missed requirements with pings for linked members
discord.point5: Every log entry mirrored, if you want

card1.text: Banned players are kicked the moment they join, and can’t apply.

card2.heading: Auto-promotion
card2.text: Rules rank people up, or recommend them, once they’ve put in the time.

card3.heading: Activity heatmap
card3.text: See which hours of the week your game is busy, in your own time zone — and plan shifts around it.

card4.heading: Quick search
card4.text: Jump to any page, group or member from anywhere in the dashboard.

card5.heading: Access requests
card5.text: Not on the whitelist yet? Ask for access right from the sign-in page.

card6.text: A single place for every group, with a button straight to it.

card8.heading: Live servers
card8.text: See every server and who is on duty, then announce, kick or shut a server down from the dashboard.

card9.heading: Roster & certifications
card9.text: Departments, callsigns and certifications that expire, award them to a whole training session at once, and check them from your game.

card10.heading: Reports
card10.text: Arrest reports, incident reports, patient care, flight logs - design the form, pick who files and who reviews, send it to Discord.

card11.text: “Other” answers, validation rules and date/time questions — on the web and in-game.

card12.heading: CSV export
card12.text: Activity, logs and the blacklist straight into a spreadsheet.
